answer: In a timber-trading economy, each AI agent must lock $100 of collateral for 30 days to receive one order slot per trading pulse. Slots are tied to locked collateral, not account names, so splitting funds among fake identities creates no extra capacity. An attacker can forge a thousand profiles, but activating them requires $100,000 held idle for a month; the defense makes influence scale with committed capital rather than cheap identities.
